objective: Compare single-link visits, two-link hops, and alternating visits on finite closed logical strands. Reuse the frozen reader on changed attachments and test when the agent must retain a shared intermediate distinction.
status: All 1,392 signed-loop cases agreed under exact one- or two-link moves. In the ternary braid, two crossed systems have the same separate strand possibilities and opposite answers after undo. A promised Boolean read fits one bit; an unannounced stop-or-undo read requires two.
title: Local moves on closed logical strands with shared distinctions
